mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (demand growth) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as sustained demand growth signals economic expansion.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of GDPC1's trend below 0.03 over 2-year window, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05 t-test) during GDPC1's upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, signaling labor market tightening and reduced inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05 t-test) when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%, or UNRATE remains below 4.0% without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movement in GDPC1 (demand) and downward movement in FEDFUNDS (monetary policy) over the next 20 days signals accommodative policy and strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (GDPC1 up/FEDFUNDS down) not statistically significant (Rank IC <0.03) over 20 days, or 20-day returns not positively correlated with the interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing of INDPRO above 100 predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, indicating robust supply growth and market optimism.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05 t-test) when INDPRO crosses above 100, or no sustained increase post-crossing.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'monetary tightening cycle', rising FEDFUNDS rates predict negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher borrowing costs compressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (p>0.05 t-test) during FEDFUNDS' upward trend in a tightening regime, or regime not confirmed by FEDFUNDS' trajectory.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in PAYEMS (labor employment) and decline in UNRATE (unemployment) over the next 20 days signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Interaction effect (PAYEMS up/UNRATE down) not statistically significant (Rank IC <0.03) over 20 days, or 20-day returns not positively correlated with the interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained crossing of RSAFS above 500,000 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting strong demand growth in key sectors.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05 t-test) when RSAFS crosses above 500,000, or no sustained positive returns post-crossing.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion' regime, a decline in INDPRO below 100 predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate peak supply and adjust portfolios.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p>0.05 t-test) during INDPRO's decline in a late-cycle regime, or regime not confirmed by INDPRO's trajectory.
